acquirer: Oakley Capital (Fund VI), with La Caisse (formerly CDPQ) as minority co-investor

deal_value.notes: Not disclosed by the parties. Sky News (via MarketScreener) reported a ~$1.35bn deal ('over GBP 1bn'); Mergersight analysis cites implied EV of ~$1.34bn. Majority stake to Oakley, minority to La Caisse, Levine Leichtman Capital Partners retains a small stake. Oakley Capital Investments' (OCI) indirect contribution is up to ~GBP 55M (not the deal value).

revenue_multiple.basis: EV / LTM revenue, per Mergersight analysis (student-run M&A review, not a tier-1/trade source; see notes)

calculable.implied_multiple: ~9-12x EV / LTM revenue (own arithmetic ~9.2x; Mergersight states ~12.4x)
calculable.calculation: Press-reported EV ~US$1.34bn / LTM revenue ~GBP 115M (~US$146M at ~1.27 USD/GBP) = ~9.2x. Mergersight itself states ~12.4x LTM EV/Revenue, which would imply ~US$108M LTM revenue - the two published figures do not reconcile.
inputs: Implied EV ~$1.34bn and LTM revenue ~GBP 115M, LTM EV/Revenue ~12.4x - Mergersight: https://www.mergersight.com/post/oakley-capital-s-1-34bn-acquisition-of-glas

40% organic revenue growth, 50% EBITDA growth over 3 years, >$750bn assets under administration, OCI contribution up to ~GBP 55M - Oakley Capital press release: https://www.oakleycapital.com/news-and-insights/oakley-capital-and-la-caisse-invest-in-institutional-debt-administration-provider-glas
calculable.caveats: Deal value is press-reported (Sky News), not confirmed by the parties; GLAS LTM revenue appears only in a secondary analysis (Mergersight) and conflicts internally with that analysis's own 12.4x multiple; official releases give only growth rates and AUA, no absolute financials.

notes: GLAS confirmed as Global Loan Agency Services (loan administration and bond trustee services), founded 2011 by Mia Drennan and Brian Carne; announced Jan 5, 2026. A revenue multiple (~12.4x LTM EV/Revenue) was published only by Mergersight, a student-run analysis site - not a credible tier per verdict rules, so the verdict is partially_calculable rather than published. Mergersight's stated multiple and its stated GBP 115M LTM revenue are mutually inconsistent against the $1.34bn EV; the page could not be fetched full-text (proxy 403) to resolve which figure is misquoted. Beware the Investing.com headline 'up to GBP 55 million' - that is OCI's fund-level contribution, not the transaction value.
